requirement.clarified: Inline LaTeX math delimited with single dollar signs ($...$) renders as raw source text instead of being typeset. Display math $$...$$ may share the same root cause — if so fix both. Scope: every MarkdownView surface. This is spec §5.16.
requirement.what: Add inline $...$ LaTeX recognition and rendering to the markdown pipeline
requirement.why: Users who ask Claude to generate math expressions see raw dollar-sign source text instead of typeset formulas, breaking the reading experience

included: Inline $...$ LaTeX recognition in span parser
Inline KaTeX rendering with displayMode: false
All MarkdownView surfaces (conversation, detail panel, tool previews)

success_criteria: Message containing $a^2 + b^2 = c^2$ renders with typeset KaTeX math, no raw dollar signs visible
Message containing $$E = mc^2$$ continues to render as centered display-math block
Message containing $100 (price) renders as plain text, not as LaTeX
Both desktop and mobile viewports render inline math correctly
constraints: Must not regress bold/italic/code/link span rendering
Must handle $price and $VARIABLE false-positive risk conservatively
Must run yarn typecheck after changes

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Inline $...$ math expressions appear as literal text (e.g. '$a^2 + b^2 = c^2$') instead of typeset math in MarkdownView
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: parseMarkdownSpans.ts regex (line 4) handles bold, italic, link, code but has no case for $...$. MarkdownSpan type has no 'latex' discriminant. The LaTeX infrastructure (LatexRenderer, parseMarkdownBlock $$...$$ detection) was added in commit f8b208fa but the inline span path was never implemented.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: f8b208fa — feat: F1 LaTeX/Mermaid + F2 image upload (2026-03-23): parseMarkdownSpans.ts was not changed in this commit
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: The original F1 LaTeX implementation focused on block-level display math ($$...$$) only. Inline $...$ was not included in scope at the time.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Any text containing inline math passes through the span parser as plain text and is rendered verbatim including the delimiter characters.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Since commit f8b208fa (2026-03-23) — the LaTeX/Mermaid feature has never included inline $...$ support

development_approach.strategy: Three-file coordinated change: (1) extend MarkdownSpan type in parseMarkdown.ts with a latex discriminant, (2) add $...$ regex case to parseMarkdownSpans.ts with false-positive guards, (3) add inline prop to LatexRenderer.tsx, (4) handle new span type in MarkdownView.tsx RenderSpanItem. The $$...$$ block path is untouched.
development_approach.validation_approach: QA: send a message containing '$a^2 + b^2 = c^2$' to an active dev session via the UI, verify rendered KaTeX in Playwright snapshot; also verify '$100 USD' renders as plain text; also verify $$...$$ block rendering unchanged. Check both desktop and mobile viewports.

research_findings.reason: Straightforward missing-feature bug with clear root cause in three specific files. KaTeX API is already used in the codebase; displayMode: false is the only new API call needed.

spec_516_note: Display math $$...$$ is confirmed WORKING (parseMarkdownBlock.ts lines 72-93 + MarkdownView.tsx line 63). It does NOT share the same root cause as inline $...$. The $$...$$ path operates at block-parser level and was implemented in f8b208fa. The inline $...$ path operates at span-parser level and was never implemented. Both use LatexRenderer but at different render levels.
